name: Sakagami Toshiya
source:
Once again, he's brilliantly secured the protagonist role? This boy.

A year has passed since his marriage to Yukari, and he should be showing a slightly more mature side than in the previous work... But...

His days continue to be thrown off balance by Yukari's overly attentive hospitality. In this installment too, he's hit with mishaps at home, at school, day and night.

“Hang in there, Toshiya!”

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/A002/03_chara.html]official site[/url]]
